name: Plant Startup Shutdown
description: Course book Module 11, Workshop 'EM Plant Start-up and Shutdown'. Command-driven equipment module: STARTUP_T101 fills Tank201 to STARTUP_LEVEL then starts MTR-203 to maintain it; SHUTDOWN_T101 shuts Tank101 down and drives Tank201 to SHUTDOWN_LEVEL before stopping the process.

STARTUP_LEVEL.description: Tank201 level that must be reached before MTR-203 is started

SHUTDOWN_LEVEL.description: Final Tank201 level before the process is shut down
